title: Crossing-focused topology visualization
description: Add purpose-specific crossing visualization to Overview/Topology using the proven analysis and existing component-safe layout/routing system.
completion_criteria: Visible-boundary markers align with real outline intersections.
Hidden-boundary markers remain readable on the associated Edge.
Focus mode emphasizes Edge, direction, role, and boundary without label or component collisions.
Minimap, pan/zoom, export, and selection use the same projected geometry.
